# verify() was a 338-line switch at nesting depth 7 mixing tree traversal,
# temporal arithmetic and inline diagnostics in one frame. Task 6.3 split it
# into one handler per node type on top of the verify_ctx_t context struct

# (SAME/AFTER/BEFORE split into verify_then_{same,after,before} plus the
# pending/valid-pair helpers), verify_or, verify_and (+ its timeout and
# per-son helpers), verify_not (+ the backtrack helper), verify_leaf and the
# shared malformed-tree tail verify_malformed_rule. Every function derived
# from verify() is <= 60 lines at nesting depth <= 4.
